title: Employee expense approval
description: Synthetic expense policy for a fictional company: reimburse small documented expenses, deny prohibited categories, and send everything else to a human approver. Synthetic content for demonstration; it authorizes nothing.

decision.intent: Decide whether a submitted expense is reimbursed automatically, denied, or reviewed by an approver.
decision.question: May this expense be reimbursed without an approver's sign-off?

evidenceRequirements.description: An itemised receipt for the expense.

sources.title: Example expense standard

citation.excerpt: Documented expenses under the small-expense threshold reimburse automatically; prohibited categories deny; everything else is reviewed.

sources.rights: Invented content for demonstration; not an operational policy.

outcomes.label: Reimburse
outcomes.description: Documented and under the threshold: reimburse automatically.

outcomes.label: Deny
outcomes.description: A prohibited category: deny with the reason recorded.

rules.description: Reimburse small documented expenses in allowed categories.

escalation.message: Escalate to the finance approver with what is missing or unknown.
